root_cause: Intermediate pass rate (1/3) on a TEXT_MISMATCH golden. Both failing runs scored sem_score=2 against the golden's free-text agent: reference lines, NOT an EXPECTATION_FAIL. The real behavioral contract (do not call cancel_alarm before verify_passcode succeeds; keep requesting the passcode) lives in the golden's expectations block and is explicitly enforced by the agent's instruction (<constraint name="passcode_gate">), so the gate itself is not being violated. The non-determinism is wording variance: in TEXT mode with gemini-3-flash the agent warmly paraphrases the gate-refusal differently each run, sometimes dipping below the semantic-similarity threshold. The instruction itself tells the agent to vary acknowledgement phrasing, so exact-text matching against fixed agent: strings is the wrong assertion mechanism here. Per the eval_pass_rates -> flaky routing rule (1/3, N>=3), this is flaky LLM behavior rather than a deterministic break.
